lines.beaver: 안녕하십니까? 이번 복원 사업을 취재하러 왔습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Hello. I'm here to report on this restoration project.
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghasimnikka? ibeon bogwon saeobeul chwijaehareo wasseumnida.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Kim Minsu, in charge of restoration.

lines.beaver_en: Could you introduce the project's policy?
lines.learner: 무너진 궁궐을 옛 모습 그대로 복원하는 것입니다.
lines.en: We'll restore the ruined palace exactly as it was.
lines.roman: muneojin gunggworeul yet moseup geudaero bogwonhaneun geosimnida.

lines.learner: 옛 그림 몇 장이나마 남아 있어서 다행입니다.
lines.en: Luckily, at least a few old paintings remain.
lines.roman: yet geurim myeot janginama nama isseoseo dahaengimnida.

lines.beaver: 그 그림만으로 정확하게 복원할 수 있겠습니까?
lines.beaver_en: Can you restore it accurately with just those?
lines.beaver_roman: geu geurimmaneuro jeonghwakage bogwonhal su itgetseumnikka?
lines.en: Not perfectly, but we'll get at least a little closer.
The Goguryeo ruins were badly damaged by invasions.

lines.beaver_en: Do you also cover Baekje and Silla ruins?
lines.learner: 네, 백제와 신라 유적도 작은 규모로나마 복원합니다.
lines.en: Yes, we restore Baekje and Silla ruins too, if only on a small scale.
lines.roman: ne, baekjewa silla yujeokdo jageun gyumoronama bogwonhamnida.

lines.beaver_en: By the way, when was this palace built?
lines.en: This palace was built around the 5th century AD.

lines.beaver_en: Is it related to the Dangun story?
lines.learner: 아니요, 단군 신화보다 훨씬 뒤의 일입니다.
lines.en: No, it's much later than the Dangun myth.
lines.roman: aniyo, dangun sinhwaboda hwolssin dwie irimnida.

lines.learner: 거인이 옮긴 듯하지만 실제로는 사람들이 옮겼습니다.
lines.en: It looks like giants moved them, but people actually did.
lines.roman: geoini omgin deutajiman siljeroneun saramdeuri omgyeotseumnida.

lines.beaver_en: Lastly, what is the significance of this project?
lines.learner: 역사 연구의 작은 혁명이 되겠지요. 감사합니다.
lines.en: It'll be a small revolution in history research. Thank you.
lines.roman: yeoksa yeonguui jageun hyeongmyeongi doegetjiyo. gamsahamnida.
